description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for gateway streaming functionality, including methods to retrieve various configuration parameters and a default method to render the configuration as a Config object. It also contains an enum for default configuration values.

classes.name: StreamingConfig
classes.description: Interface providing configuration settings for gateway streaming, including methods to access specific configuration parameters and a default method to render the configuration into a Config object.

methods.name: getSessionCounterScrapeInterval
methods.description: Returns the session counter update interval.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementConfig
methods.description: Returns the acknowledgement configuration for streaming sessions.

methods.name: getWebsocketConfig
methods.description: Returns the websocket configuration for streaming.

methods.name: getParallelism
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of stream elements to process in parallel.

methods.name: getSearchIdleTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration before closing an idle search stream.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the configuration into a Config object.

enum.name: StreamingConfigValue
enum.description: Enumeration of known configuration path expressions and their default values.

values.name: SESSION_COUNTER_SCRAPE_INTERVAL
values.description: Update interval for websocket session counter.

values.name: PARALLELISM
values.description: Maximum number of stream elements to process in parallel.

values.name: SEARCH_IDLE_TIMEOUT
values.description: Timeout duration before closing an idle search stream.
